entities.summary: John Jonston or Johnston was a Polish scholar and physician, descended from Scottish nobility and closely associated with the Polish magnate Leszczyński family. The standard author abbreviation Jonst. is used to indicate this person as the author when citing a botanical name. John Jonston was a journalists & chroniclers from Szamotuły (1603-09-03, Szamotuły–1675-06-08). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
